name: Robowars
description: Witness the ultimate clash of steel and circuits! Teams from across the campus pit their custom-built robots against each other in a thrilling combat tournament. Sparks will fly!

name: Aquawars
description: A unique challenge where autonomous aquatic robots navigate a series of complex underwater obstacles in the IITG lake. A test of engineering, programming, and buoyancy!

name: Escalade
description: A premier startup pitch competition. Watch as budding entrepreneurs present their groundbreaking ideas to a panel of venture capitalists and industry leaders. Who will secure the next big investment?

name: UVDC (UAV Design Challenge)
description: The Unmanned Vehicle Design Challenge finals! Teams showcase their autonomous drones, judged on flight performance, design innovation, and mission execution. See the future of aerial robotics.

name: Track Titans
description: An intense 24-hour hackathon where teams race against the clock to develop innovative software solutions for real-world problems. The ultimate test of coding speed and creativity.

name: Micromouse
description: A classic robotics competition where small autonomous robots navigate a complex maze to find the center. It's a high-speed challenge of algorithm design and sensor precision.
